sections.label: ↔ Pol
sections.description: Stack parallel and perpendicular detector-routing channels for anisotropy-aware filter computation.

sections.label: ▤ AP
sections.description: Add a constant microtime basis pattern representing afterpulsing and uniform dark-count background.

sections.label: ⚡ IRF
sections.description: Model scattered excitation light (the IRF) as a nuisance component. Each detector's measured IRF file, or its synthetic-IRF Width/Skew, is set per row in the Detectors table below. Afterpulse and scatter/IRF are always absorbed by their filters and excluded from the correlation-facing output.
